blocks.zh: 核心概念：不合格品的四種處置路徑
blocks.en: Core Concept: The Four Disposition Paths for Nonconforming Product

blocks.zh: 返工 (Rework)：最常見的選擇，但有條件——必須有書面返工程序，且返工後必須按原驗收標準重新測試。返工不能降低測試要求。DHR 必須顯示「原始測試失敗→返工記錄→重新測試通過」的完整鏈條。
blocks.en: Rework: The most common choice, but with conditions. There must be a documented rework procedure, and after rework the product must be retested against the original acceptance criteria. Rework must not lower the testing requirements. The DHR must show the complete chain: original test failure, rework record, retest passed.

blocks.zh: 報廢 (Scrap)：最簡單但成本最高。適用於無法返工或返工成本不合理的情況。報廢記錄必須包含數量和銷毀方法——不能只寫「已丟棄」。
blocks.en: Scrap: The simplest option but the most costly. It applies when the product cannot be reworked or when the cost of rework is unreasonable. The scrap record must include the quantity and the destruction method; it is not enough to write "discarded".

blocks.zh: 讓步接收 (Use-as-Is/Concession)：風險最高的選擇。需要書面風險評估說明為何不合格不影響安全性和有效性。對於安全關鍵的不合格（如無菌性失效、標籤錯誤），絕不能使用讓步接收。
blocks.en: Use-as-Is / Concession: The highest-risk option. A documented risk assessment is needed to explain why the nonconformity does not affect safety and effectiveness. For safety-critical nonconformities (such as a sterility failure or a labeling error), use-as-is concession must never be used.

blocks.zh: 退貨供應商 (Return to Supplier)：用於進料不合格。必須配合供應商 CAPA 要求，否則問題會反覆出現。
blocks.en: Return to Supplier: Used for incoming nonconformities. It must be combined with a supplier CAPA request; otherwise the problem will keep recurring.

blocks.zh: 比喻說明 Analogy
blocks.en: Analogy

blocks.zh: 不合格品管理就像餐廳的食材品管：
blocks.en: Nonconforming product control is like quality control of ingredients in a restaurant:

blocks.zh: 識別/隔離 = 廚師發現過期食材，立即貼「禁用」標籤並放入單獨冰箱
blocks.en: Identification/segregation = the chef finds an expired ingredient, immediately attaches a "Do Not Use" label and puts it in a separate refrigerator

blocks.zh: 返工 = 蔬菜有瑕疵部分，切掉壞的部分後仍可使用，但要重新檢查
blocks.en: Rework = a vegetable has a blemished part; cut off the bad part and the rest can still be used, but it must be inspected again

blocks.zh: 報廢 = 整批食材已變質，全部丟棄
blocks.en: Scrap = the whole batch of ingredients has spoiled and is all thrown away

blocks.zh: 讓步接收 = 蔬菜賣相不佳但食用安全，做成湯品（必須記錄決策理由）
blocks.en: Use-as-is concession = the vegetable looks poor but is safe to eat, so it is made into soup (the reason for the decision must be recorded)

blocks.zh: 退貨 = 供應商送來的食材不符規格，整批退回
blocks.en: Return = the ingredients delivered by the supplier do not meet the specification, so the whole batch is sent back

blocks.zh: 差異在於：醫療器材的「讓步接收」需要書面風險評估，而食材只需主廚判斷——法規要求的是可查核的紀錄，而非個人判斷。
blocks.en: The difference: for a medical device, a "use-as-is concession" requires a documented risk assessment, whereas in a restaurant the head chef's judgment is enough. The regulation requires auditable records, not personal judgment.

blocks.zh: FDA 483 陷阱 Inspection Trap
blocks.en: FDA 483 Inspection Trap

blocks.zh: ★ 返工程序缺失：最常見觀察項之一。公司進行了返工，但 SOP 中沒有書面返工程序，也沒有評估返工對產品品質的潛在影響。FDA 要求返工程序必須是預先批准的（pre-approved），而非事後臨時制定的。
blocks.en: ★ Missing rework procedure: One of the most common observations. The company performed rework, but there is no documented rework procedure in the SOPs and no evaluation of the potential impact of rework on product quality. FDA expects the rework procedure to be pre-approved, not drawn up after the fact.

blocks.zh: ★ 讓步接收未做風險評估：Use-as-Is 決策僅憑口頭確認或 email，沒有正式的書面風險評估和批准。
blocks.en: ★ Use-as-is concession without a risk assessment: The use-as-is decision rests only on verbal confirmation or an email, with no formal documented risk assessment and approval.

blocks.zh: ★ 不合格品未與合格品物理隔離：在同一倉儲區域混放，僅靠 ERP 系統標記——當系統標記被誤解，就有放行風險。
blocks.en: ★ Nonconforming product not physically segregated from conforming product: The two are mixed in the same warehouse area and separated only by an ERP status flag. If the flag is misread, there is a risk of release.

blocks.zh: ★ 已放行產品的不合格未評估 MDR：收到客戶投訴說明某批產品有製程不合格，但公司僅處理了退貨，沒有評估是否需要提交 MDR。
blocks.en: ★ Nonconformity in released product not evaluated for MDR: A customer complaint indicates that a batch had a process nonconformity, but the company only handled the return and did not evaluate whether an MDR needs to be submitted.

blocks.zh: 練習思考 Practice Scenarios
blocks.en: Practice Scenarios

blocks.zh: 一批注射器活塞在充填後發現尺寸超出規格（+0.1mm），檢驗員進行了讓步接收但未填寫任何書面評估。這違反了哪些 QMSR 要求？
blocks.en: After filling, a batch of syringe plungers was found to be out of specification dimensionally (+0.1 mm). The inspector granted a use-as-is concession without completing any documented evaluation. Which QMSR requirements does this violate?

blocks.zh: 原廠生產的導管在最終檢驗時 5% 樣品有表面擦傷，決定全批返工重新拋光。返工後的再測試只做了外觀檢查，沒有重複機械強度測試。這有什麼問題？
blocks.en: At final inspection, 5% of the sampled catheters from the original manufacturer had surface scratches, and the decision was to rework and repolish the whole batch. The retest after rework consisted only of a visual inspection, with no repeat of the mechanical strength test. What is wrong with this?

blocks.zh: 同一不合格模式（某零組件尺寸偏差）在過去 6 個月出現 8 次，每次都做了讓步接收並單獨結案。這符合 QMSR 要求嗎？
blocks.en: The same nonconformity pattern (a dimensional deviation in one component) occurred 8 times in the past 6 months, and each time it was dispositioned as a use-as-is concession and closed individually. Does this meet QMSR requirements?

blocks.en: 4.2 CAPA — Corrective and Preventive Action (ISO 13485 §8.5.2 / §8.5.3)

blocks.zh: 根本原因分析工具實戰指南
blocks.en: A Practical Guide to Root Cause Analysis Tools

blocks.zh: 5-Why 範例： 問題：產品包裝出現標籤錯誤
blocks.en: 5-Why example: Problem: a labeling error appears on the product packaging

blocks.zh: Why 1：標籤印刷錯誤 → Why 2：標籤模板未及時更新 → Why 3：設計變更沒有通知包裝部門 → Why 4：設計變更的通知程序只涵蓋製造部門 → Why 5：根本原因：設計變更管控程序（DCO）未涵蓋所有受影響部門的通知義務
blocks.en: Why 1: The label was printed incorrectly → Why 2: The label template was not updated in time → Why 3: The design change was not communicated to the packaging department → Why 4: The notification procedure for design changes covered only the manufacturing department → Why 5: Root cause: the design change control procedure (DCO) does not cover the notification obligations to all affected departments

blocks.zh: 注意：5-Why 的「5」只是指導性數字——有時 3 次就找到根本原因，有時需要 7 次。關鍵是要問到「系統性」根因，而不是個人錯誤層面停下。
blocks.en: Note: the "5" in 5-Why is only a guideline. Sometimes the root cause is found after 3 whys, sometimes it takes 7. The key is to keep asking until you reach a systemic root cause, rather than stopping at the level of individual error.

blocks.zh: 魚骨圖（Ishikawa）的 6M 架構：
blocks.en: The 6M structure of the fishbone (Ishikawa) diagram:

blocks.zh: Man（人員）：培訓不足、人員輪換、溝通失誤
blocks.en: Man (people): inadequate training, staff rotation, communication errors

blocks.zh: Machine（設備）：設備故障、校驗過期、維護不足
blocks.en: Machine (equipment): equipment failure, overdue calibration, inadequate maintenance

blocks.zh: Material（物料）：原材料變異、供應商更換
blocks.en: Material: raw material variability, change of supplier

blocks.zh: Method（方法）：SOP 不清晰、步驟缺失、流程設計缺陷
blocks.en: Method: unclear SOPs, missing steps, flawed process design

blocks.zh: Measurement（量測）：測試方法誤差、儀器漂移
blocks.en: Measurement: test method error, instrument drift

blocks.zh: Environment（環境）：溫濕度、潔淨室污染、震動
blocks.en: Environment: temperature and humidity, cleanroom contamination, vibration

blocks.zh: FTA（故障樹分析）：從頂層失效事件向下展開，識別所有可能的失效路徑組合。適用於複雜產品的系統性安全失效分析。FDA 要求在高風險器材的 CAPA 中考慮使用 FTA。
blocks.en: FTA (Fault Tree Analysis): Starting from the top-level failure event and working downward, it identifies all possible combinations of failure paths. It is suited to systematic safety failure analysis of complex products. FDA expects FTA to be considered in the CAPA for high-risk devices.

blocks.zh: 比喻說明：CAPA vs 偏差 Analogy
blocks.en: Analogy: CAPA vs Deviation

blocks.zh: 偏差（Deviation）就像「單次感冒」——你服藥（即時處置），症狀消失，不需要系統性改變生活習慣。每次偏差都記錄、處理、結案。
blocks.en: A deviation is like "a single cold": you take medicine (immediate correction), the symptoms go away, and you do not need to change your lifestyle systematically. Every deviation is recorded, handled and closed.

blocks.zh: CAPA就像「免疫系統的系統性重建」——如果你一年感冒 10 次，光靠吃藥不夠，必須找根本原因（睡眠不足？免疫力低下？工作環境？），然後系統性地改變（調整作息、補充營養、改善環境），並追蹤半年確認改善效果（有效性驗證）。
blocks.en: CAPA is like "systematically rebuilding the immune system": if you catch a cold 10 times a year, medicine alone is not enough. You must find the root cause (lack of sleep? low immunity? the work environment?), then make systematic changes (adjust your routine, improve nutrition, improve your environment), and follow up for six months to confirm the improvement (verification of effectiveness).

blocks.zh: 關鍵差異：偏差是單次事件的即時管控；CAPA 是對系統性缺陷的根本修復。FDA 查廠員最常問的問題是：「你的 CAPA 系統有沒有把重複出現的偏差升級為 CAPA？」
blocks.en: The key difference: a deviation is immediate control of a single event; CAPA is the fundamental repair of a systemic defect. The question FDA investigators ask most often is: "Does your CAPA system escalate recurring deviations to CAPA?"

blocks.zh: FDA 483 / Warning Letter 高頻觀察項
blocks.en: High-Frequency FDA 483 / Warning Letter Observations

blocks.zh: ★ CAPA 未結案（最常見 #1）：大量 CAPA 開了數月甚至數年，無結案日期，無有效性驗證。FDA 查廠員通常會要求看「過去 12 個月所有 CAPA 的狀態報告」。
blocks.en: ★ CAPAs not closed (most common, #1): Large numbers of CAPAs have been open for months or even years, with no closure date and no effectiveness verification. FDA investigators will usually ask to see "a status report of all CAPAs over the past 12 months".

blocks.zh: ★ 有效性驗證缺失（最常見 #2）：CAPA 結案時，有效性驗證欄位填「N/A」或「Implementation completed」而沒有收集數據。這直接否定了整個 CAPA 的意義。
blocks.en: ★ Missing effectiveness verification (most common, #2): When the CAPA is closed, the effectiveness verification field says "N/A" or "Implementation completed" and no data were collected. This directly negates the whole purpose of the CAPA.

blocks.zh: ★ 根本原因停在表層：RCA 只寫「操作員未遵守 SOP」，沒有繼續追問「為什麼操作員不遵守 SOP」——可能是 SOP 設計有缺陷、培訓不足、或工作負荷過重。
blocks.en: ★ Root cause stops at the surface: The RCA only states "operator did not follow the SOP" and does not go on to ask "why did the operator not follow the SOP?" The cause may be a flawed SOP design, insufficient training or an excessive workload.

blocks.zh: ★ 偏差未升級 CAPA：系統顯示同一類型偏差在過去 6 個月出現 12 次，每次都單獨結案，從未觸發 CAPA。這是趨勢分析（Trend Analysis）系統失效的表現。
blocks.en: ★ Deviations not escalated to CAPA: The system shows that the same type of deviation occurred 12 times in the past 6 months, each closed individually, and never triggered a CAPA. This indicates that the trend analysis system has failed.

blocks.zh: ★ PA（預防措施）完全缺失：公司只有 CA，沒有 PA。在管理審查中，PA 輸入為空白。FDA 認為缺少 PA 代表 QMS 是被動反應式，而非主動預防式。
blocks.en: ★ Preventive action (PA) completely missing: The company has only CA and no PA. In the management review, the PA input is blank. FDA considers the lack of PA to mean that the QMS is reactive rather than proactive.

blocks.zh: CAPA 有效性驗證計算範例
blocks.en: Worked Example: CAPA Effectiveness Verification

blocks.zh:
CAPA 觸發原因：封裝密封失效率 = 3.2%（規格：≤0.5%）
根本原因：熱封機溫度漂移（發現校驗記錄 6 個月過期）

有效性驗證標準設定：
───────────────────────────────────────────────────────
VoE 指標：密封失效率（Seal Failure Rate）
VoE 時間窗：行動實施後連續 90 天生產數據
VoE 接受標準：密封失效率 ≤ 0.5%（≥3 批次，n ≥ 300/批）
VoE 責任人：QE Engineer（姓名），目標結案日：[日期+90天]
───────────────────────────────────────────────────────
行動：重新校驗熱封機 + 每週預防性校驗計劃 + SOP修訂
實施日期：[日期]

VoE 結果（90天後）：
批次 A：失效率 0.2%（通過）
批次 B：失效率 0.3%（通過）
批次 C：失效率 0.1%（通過）
→ VoE 通過，CAPA 結案，日期：[日期]
blocks.en:
CAPA trigger: package seal failure rate = 3.2% (specification: ≤0.5%)
Root cause: heat sealer temperature drift (calibration record found to be 6 months overdue)

Setting the effectiveness verification criteria:
───────────────────────────────────────────────────────
VoE metric: seal failure rate
VoE window: production data for 90 consecutive days after the action is implemented
VoE acceptance criterion: seal failure rate ≤ 0.5% (≥3 batches, n ≥ 300 per batch)
VoE owner: QE Engineer (name), target closure date: [date + 90 days]
───────────────────────────────────────────────────────
Actions: recalibrate the heat sealer + weekly preventive calibration plan + SOP revision
Implementation date: [date]

VoE results (after 90 days):
Batch A: failure rate 0.2% (pass)
Batch B: failure rate 0.3% (pass)
Batch C: failure rate 0.1% (pass)
→ VoE passed, CAPA closed, date: [date]

blocks.zh: 注意：如果 VoE 收集期間有任何批次超標，VoE 失敗，CAPA 必須重新開啟並進行更深層的根因分析。
blocks.en: Note: if any batch exceeds the limit during the VoE collection period, the VoE has failed, and the CAPA must be reopened and a deeper root cause analysis performed.

blocks.zh: 練習思考 Practice Questions
blocks.en: Practice Questions

blocks.zh: 你的公司在過去 3 個月收到 15 份 CAPA，其中 8 份已逾期 30 天以上，3 份逾期 90 天。FDA 查廠員要求看 CAPA 狀態報告。你需要如何解釋和應對？
blocks.en: Your company received 15 CAPAs in the past 3 months. Of these, 8 are more than 30 days overdue and 3 are more than 90 days overdue. An FDA investigator asks to see the CAPA status report. How do you explain and respond?

blocks.zh: 一項 CAPA 的根本原因分析結論是「操作員培訓不足」，矯正行動是「重新培訓操作員並更新培訓記錄」。這個 CAPA 的有效性如何驗證？設計一個具體的 VoE 計劃。
blocks.en: The root cause analysis conclusion of a CAPA is "operator training was insufficient", and the corrective action is "retrain the operators and update the training records". How would the effectiveness of this CAPA be verified? Design a specific VoE plan.

blocks.zh: 預防措施（PA）的觸發源應包括哪些？你的公司每月管理審查中，PA 輸入欄應包含哪些數據類型？
blocks.en: What sources should trigger preventive action (PA)? What types of data should the PA input section contain in your company's monthly management review?

blocks.zh: CAPA 系統的六個核心組件
blocks.en: The Six Core Components of a CAPA System

blocks.zh: 閉環（Closed-Loop）的含義： CAPA 最重要的特性是「閉環」——每個 CAPA 必須有明確的結案條件（VoE 通過）。FDA 查廠最常見的問題是：CAPA 開了但從未結案，或者結案時沒有有效性驗證數據。
blocks.en: What "closed-loop" means: The most important feature of CAPA is that it is "closed-loop": every CAPA must have clear closure criteria (VoE passed). The problem FDA investigators find most often is that a CAPA was opened but never closed, or was closed without effectiveness verification data.

blocks.en: 4.3 Complaint Files — §820.198 (FDA-Specific, Not in ISO 13485)

blocks.zh: FDA 483 陷阱：投訴→MDR 的致命斷點
blocks.en: FDA 483 Inspection Trap: The Fatal Break Between Complaint and MDR

blocks.zh: ★ 最危險的 483 觀察項：投訴未升級 MDR。這不只是程序問題，可能導致 Warning Letter 甚至刑事調查。常見場景：客服人員接到醫院說「患者術中設備失效，手術被迫中止」，客服記錄為「產品投訴」，傳給 QA，QA 認為「手術中止不等於嚴重傷害」，未提交 MDR。FDA 最終查到：手術被迫中止屬於「嚴重傷害（serious injury）」範疇，應在 30 天內提交 MDR。
blocks.en: ★ The most dangerous 483 observation: complaint not escalated to MDR. This is not just a procedural issue; it can lead to a Warning Letter or even a criminal investigation. A common scenario: a customer service representative takes a call from a hospital saying "the device failed during surgery and the procedure had to be aborted". Customer service logs it as a "product complaint" and passes it to QA, and QA decides that "an aborted surgery is not a serious injury" and does not submit an MDR. FDA eventually finds that a forced surgical abort falls within the scope of "serious injury", and an MDR should have been submitted within 30 days.

blocks.zh: ★ 口頭投訴未書面化：銷售人員接到客戶電話投訴，在 CRM 系統記錄了「客戶不滿意」，但未按投訴定義進行正式書面記錄和 QA 流轉。這些「隱藏投訴」在 FDA 查廠時若從 CRM 系統或郵件中被挖出，將成為重大 483 觀察項。
blocks.en: ★ Oral complaints not documented: A salesperson receives a complaint by phone and records "customer dissatisfied" in the CRM system, but does not create a formal written record or route it to QA as the complaint definition requires. If these "hidden complaints" are dug out of the CRM system or email during an FDA inspection, they become a major 483 observation.

blocks.zh: ★ MDR 決策無文件記錄：投訴文件的 MDR 欄位空白，或只寫「Not Reportable」但沒有記錄是誰決定的、決定的日期、和決定依據。§820.198(d) 要求 MDR 決策必須文件化，即使決定不報告也必須記錄理由。
blocks.en: ★ No documentation of the MDR decision: The MDR field in the complaint file is blank, or says only "Not Reportable" without recording who made the decision, the date of the decision and the basis for it. §820.198(d) requires the MDR decision to be documented, and the rationale must be recorded even when the decision is not to report.

blocks.zh: ★ 30 天計時起點誤解：計時起點是「獲知可能構成 MDR 事件的信息之日」，而非「調查完成日」或「確認因果關係之日」。只要有「合理懷疑（reasonable suggestion）」，30 天就開始計時。
blocks.en: ★ Misunderstanding the start of the 30-day clock: The clock starts on "the date the company becomes aware of information that may constitute an MDR event", not on "the date the investigation is completed" or "the date causation is confirmed". As soon as there is a "reasonable suggestion", the 30 days begin to run.

blocks.zh: MDR 30 天時限計算
blocks.en: Calculating the MDR 30-Day Deadline

blocks.zh:
MDR 30 天計時規則（21 CFR §803.20）：
──────────────────────────────────────────────────────
計時起點（Day 0）：
  製造商/進口商「獲知（becomes aware of）」信息，
  該信息合理表明（reasonably suggests）發生了
  MDR reportable 事件

  注意：「獲知」≠「確認」。信息到達公司任何員工即算起
  （包括銷售人員、技術人員、客服人員）

計算示例：
  Day 0：客服收到投訴電話（記錄時間）
  Day 1-5：投訴書面化，傳 QA
  Day 5：QA 初步評估，認為可能涉及死亡/嚴重傷害
  Day 6-25：調查（器材回收、技術評估、臨床數據收集）
  Day 30（截止）：必須向 FDA 提交 MedWatch 3500A

如果無法在 30 天內完成完整調查：
  提交初始報告（Initial Report）：在 Day 30 前提交已知信息
  提交補充報告（Supplemental Report）：調查完成後補充
  → 晚報比不報好，但不報是違法的
──────────────────────────────────────────────────────

MDR 判斷樹：
投訴到達 QA
  │
  ├─ 涉及已配發設備？ → 否 → 非 MDR，記錄結論
  │                     ↓ 是
  ├─ 設備可能導致死亡？ → 是 → 30天MDR + 5天緊急報告（若確認死亡）
  │
  ├─ 設備可能導致嚴重傷害？ → 是 → 30天MDR
  │  （「嚴重傷害」= 危及生命、導致永久損傷、需醫療干預、
  │   住院或延長住院、先天性異常或缺陷）
  │
  ├─ 設備發生故障且若再次發生可能導致上述後果？
  │  → 是 → 30天MDR（故障型MDR）
  │
  └─ 以上都否 → 非MDR報告事件，記錄決定和依據

注意：5天緊急MDR適用於廠商通過PMA批准後公眾健康威脅的緊急情況
blocks.en:
MDR 30-day clock rules (21 CFR §803.20):
──────────────────────────────────────────────────────
Clock start (Day 0):
  The manufacturer/importer "becomes aware of" information
  that reasonably suggests that an MDR reportable event
  has occurred

  Note: "becomes aware" ≠ "confirms". The clock starts once the
  information reaches any employee of the company
  (including sales, technical and customer service staff)

Example calculation:
  Day 0: Customer service receives the complaint call (record the time)
  Day 1-5: Complaint documented in writing and passed to QA
  Day 5: QA preliminary assessment; death/serious injury may be involved
  Day 6-25: Investigation (device retrieval, technical evaluation, clinical data collection)
  Day 30 (deadline): MedWatch 3500A must be submitted to FDA

If the full investigation cannot be completed within 30 days:
  Submit an Initial Report: submit the known information before Day 30
  Submit a Supplemental Report: add to it once the investigation is complete
  → A late report is better than none, but not reporting is unlawful
──────────────────────────────────────────────────────

MDR decision tree:
Complaint reaches QA
  │
  ├─ Does it involve a distributed device? → No → Not an MDR; document the conclusion
  │                     ↓ Yes
  ├─ May the device have caused a death? → Yes → 30-day MDR + 5-day emergency report (if death is confirmed)
  │
  ├─ May the device have caused a serious injury? → Yes → 30-day MDR
  │  ("Serious injury" = life-threatening, results in permanent impairment, requires medical intervention,
  │   hospitalization or prolonged hospitalization, congenital anomaly or defect)
  │
  ├─ Did the device malfunction, and would a recurrence be likely to cause the above outcomes?
  │  → Yes → 30-day MDR (malfunction-type MDR)
  │
  └─ None of the above → Not an MDR reportable event; document the decision and its basis

Note: The 5-day emergency MDR applies to situations where, after PMA approval, the manufacturer must report a public health threat on an emergency basis

blocks.zh: 練習思考：這算投訴嗎？這需要 MDR 嗎？
blocks.en: Practice: Is This a Complaint? Does This Need an MDR?

blocks.zh: 場景 1：一家醫院的生物醫學工程師打電話說，你公司的輸液泵在夜班出現報警並自動停止輸液，但患者未受傷，泵已自行重置正常運作。
blocks.en: Scenario 1: A hospital biomedical engineer calls to say that your company's infusion pump alarmed and stopped infusing automatically during the night shift. The patient was not injured, and the pump reset itself and resumed normal operation.

blocks.zh: 算投訴嗎？ 是/否？（提示：考慮可靠性缺陷主張）
blocks.en: Is it a complaint? Yes/No? (Hint: consider claims of reliability deficiency)

blocks.zh: 需要 MDR 嗎？ 是/否？（提示：考慮「malfunction + 若再次發生是否可能導致嚴重傷害」）
blocks.en: Does it need an MDR? Yes/No? (Hint: consider "malfunction + whether a recurrence could be likely to cause serious injury")

blocks.zh: 場景 2：一個患者的家屬在社交媒體發帖，稱你公司的心臟節律器「時常發出奇怪響聲」，但沒有說明是否就醫。你的社媒監控系統捕捉到這條帖子。
blocks.en: Scenario 2: A patient's family member posts on social media that your company's pacemaker "often makes a strange sound", without saying whether medical care was sought. Your social media monitoring system captures the post.

blocks.zh: 算投訴嗎？需要調查嗎？
blocks.en: Is it a complaint? Does it need to be investigated?

blocks.zh: 如何記錄「投訴方的聯繫方式無法獲得」的情況？
blocks.en: How do you document the situation where "the complainant's contact information cannot be obtained"?

blocks.zh: 場景 3：歐洲的分銷商提交了一份書面報告，說明有 3 台設備在保修期內出現顯示屏故障，均已退回更換。分銷商認為這是「質量問題」但未提及任何患者傷害。
blocks.en: Scenario 3: A European distributor submits a written report describing 3 devices that developed display faults within the warranty period, all returned for replacement. The distributor considers this a "quality problem" but does not mention any patient injury.

blocks.zh: 這在 §820.198 下算投訴嗎？即使在美國境外發生？
blocks.en: Does this count as a complaint under §820.198, even though it occurred outside the United States?

blocks.zh: 是否需要 MDR？考慮設備用途和顯示屏故障的潛在風險。
blocks.en: Is an MDR required? Consider the intended use of the device and the potential risk of the display fault.

blocks.zh: §820.198 投訴文件系統：五大核心要素
blocks.en: The §820.198 Complaint File System: Five Core Elements

blocks.zh: 理解 §820.198 最重要的框架是：它不只是「收集投訴」，而是建立一個從投訴接收到 MDR 決策的完整閉環系統。
blocks.en: The most important framework for understanding §820.198 is that it is not just about "collecting complaints"; it establishes a complete closed-loop system from complaint receipt to the MDR decision.

blocks.zh: 投訴定義的邊界：這算不算投訴？
blocks.en: Boundaries of the Complaint Definition: Is This a Complaint?

blocks.zh: §820.198 最容易被誤解的是投訴的定義範圍。以下場景分析：
blocks.en: The scope of the complaint definition is the part of §820.198 most easily misunderstood. The following scenarios are analyzed:

blocks.zh: * 配發給調查機構（distributed）的研究用設備在 IDE 框架下，某些失效仍需按 §812.150 報告。
blocks.en: * Investigational devices distributed to investigators under an IDE framework: certain failures must still be reported under §812.150.

blocks.zh: 4.4 Internal Audit (ISO 13485 §8.2.4) 4.4 內部稽核（ISO 13485 §8.2.4）
blocks.en: 4.4 Internal Audit (ISO 13485 §8.2.4)

blocks.zh: 內部稽核計劃的設計原則
blocks.en: Design Principles for the Internal Audit Program

blocks.zh: 風險分層稽核頻率：不是所有流程都需要一年稽核一次——高風險流程（無菌充填、滅菌確效、CAPA 系統、投訴管理）應每年稽核 2 次甚至更頻繁，而低風險行政流程（文件控制、培訓管理）每年 1 次可能就夠。稽核頻率的風險分層依據應記錄在稽核計劃中。
blocks.en: Risk-based audit frequency: Not every process needs to be audited once a year. High-risk processes (aseptic filling, sterilization validation, the CAPA system, complaint handling) should be audited twice a year or even more often, while low-risk administrative processes (document control, training management) may need only one audit a year. The rationale for the risk-based tiering of audit frequency should be documented in the audit program.

blocks.zh: 稽核員獨立性的實務解法：對於小型組織（50 人以下），完全的部門獨立性很難實現。常見合規解法：
blocks.en: Practical solutions for auditor independence: For small organizations (under 50 people), full departmental independence is hard to achieve. Common compliant solutions:

blocks.zh: 建立交叉稽核矩陣（Cross-audit matrix）：QA 稽核生產，生產主管稽核倉儲，倉儲主管稽核 QC 實驗室
blocks.en: Establish a cross-audit matrix: QA audits production, the production supervisor audits the warehouse, and the warehouse supervisor audits the QC laboratory

blocks.zh: 聘請外部稽核員（Contract Auditor）每年執行至少一次完整系統稽核
blocks.en: Engage a contract auditor to perform at least one full system audit each year

blocks.zh: 利用 FDA/Notified Body 的稽核發現作為補充
blocks.en: Use the findings of FDA/Notified Body audits as a supplement

blocks.zh: 內部稽核就像企業的「年度健康檢查」——定期、系統性地評估 QMS 的健康狀況。差別在於：
blocks.en: An internal audit is like a company's "annual health checkup": a regular, systematic assessment of the health of the QMS. The difference lies in how it is done:

blocks.zh: 好的稽核 = 像主動去做健康檢查，找出早期問題並預防
blocks.en: A good audit = like proactively going for a health checkup, finding early problems and preventing them

blocks.zh: 差的稽核 = 像只有在 FDA 查廠前 2 週才臨時「補稽」——走個形式，沒有發現真實問題
blocks.en: A poor audit = like a last-minute "catch-up audit" done only 2 weeks before an FDA inspection: a box-ticking exercise that finds no real problems

blocks.zh: FDA 查廠員會要求看內部稽核記錄，並特別關注：稽核發現是否真實（有沒有找到問題），或者稽核報告永遠都是「零發現」（代表稽核員要麼不稱職，要麼被告知不能發現問題）。
blocks.en: FDA investigators will ask to see the internal audit records and pay particular attention to whether the audit findings are genuine (whether any problems were actually found) or whether the audit reports always show "zero findings" (which suggests that the auditors are either not competent or have been told not to find problems).

blocks.zh: FDA 查廠對內部稽核的重點關注
blocks.en: Key FDA Inspection Focus Areas for Internal Audits

blocks.zh: ★ 稽核計劃未涵蓋全部 QMS 要素：公司有稽核計劃，但過去 2 年從未稽核過投訴管理或 CAPA 系統。FDA 查廠員可據此認定 QMS 的內部稽核不完整。
blocks.en: ★ Audit program does not cover all QMS elements: The company has an audit program, but in the past 2 years it has never audited complaint handling or the CAPA system. FDA investigators may conclude on this basis that the QMS internal audit is incomplete.

blocks.zh: ★ 稽核員無資格記錄：稽核員只有一行描述「已完成稽核培訓」，但沒有稽核員資格評估記錄（稽核技術課程、考核成績、OJT 記錄）。
blocks.en: ★ No auditor qualification records: The auditor has only a one-line description saying "completed audit training", but no auditor qualification assessment records (audit technique courses, assessment results, OJT records).

blocks.zh: ★ 稽核發現未連結 CAPA：稽核報告中有 Major 不合格，但沒有開立 CAPA，只有「改善計劃」郵件。ISO 13485 §8.2.4 明確要求稽核不合格必須啟動 CAPA。
blocks.en: ★ Audit findings not linked to CAPA: The audit report contains a major nonconformity, but no CAPA was opened; there is only an "improvement plan" email. ISO 13485 §8.2.4 explicitly requires that audit nonconformities initiate CAPA.

blocks.zh: ★ 稽核發現的矯正行動未驗證：上次稽核的不合格矯正行動寫「已完成」，但沒有後續驗證記錄確認矯正行動的有效性。
blocks.en: ★ Corrective actions for audit findings not verified: The corrective action for a nonconformity from the previous audit is recorded as "completed", but there is no follow-up verification record confirming the effectiveness of the corrective action.

blocks.zh: 4.5 Records Requirements (ISO 13485 §4.2.4 + QMSR) 4.5 紀錄要求（ISO 13485 §4.2.4 + QMSR）
blocks.en: 4.5 Records Requirements (ISO 13485 §4.2.4 + QMSR)

blocks.zh: 記錄保存期限計算公式
blocks.en: Formula for Calculating the Record Retention Period

Minimum record retention period = MAX( device design life, 2 years )
Start of count = date of manufacture (not release date, not sale date)

Example calculations:
───────────────────────────────────────────────
Device: orthopedic implant (design life = 15 years)
Date of manufacture: 2026-01-15
Release date: 2026-02-20

Retention deadline:
  ISO 13485 calculation: 2026-01-15 + 15 years = 2041-01-15
  FDA QMSR calculation: 2026-01-15 + 15 years = 2041-01-15
  → Retain until after 2041-01-15

Device: diagnostic test kit (design life = 18 months)
Date of manufacture: 2026-03-10
Retention deadline:
  2-year calculation: 2026-03-10 + 2 years = 2028-03-10
  → Retain until 2028-03-10 (2 years > 18 months, take the larger)
───────────────────────────────────────────────

Comparison with EU MDR (EU 2017/745):
Implantable devices: 15 years
Other devices: 10 years
(Start of count = release date of the last product)

blocks.zh: 21 CFR Part 11 電子記錄合規要點
blocks.en: Key Compliance Points for 21 CFR Part 11 Electronic Records

blocks.zh: 稽核追蹤（Audit Trail）是核心：電子系統必須自動捕獲每一次記錄的創建、修改、刪除操作，並記錄：操作人員 ID、操作日期/時間（不可修改）、原始值和更改後值、更改理由（通常強制填寫）。稽核追蹤不能被操作人員自己關閉或刪除。
blocks.en: The audit trail is central: The electronic system must automatically capture every creation, modification and deletion of a record, and log: the operator ID, the date/time of the operation (not alterable), the original and changed values, and the reason for the change (usually mandatory). The audit trail must not be disabled or deleted by the operators themselves.

blocks.zh: 系統驗證要求：ERP、MES、LIMS、eQMS 等用於 GMP 記錄的電子系統都需要驗證。驗證範圍包括：安裝驗證（IQ）、操作驗證（OQ）、效能驗證（PQ）。系統升級後需要重新驗證受影響功能。
blocks.en: System validation requirements: Electronic systems used for GMP records, such as ERP, MES, LIMS and eQMS, all require validation. The validation scope includes installation qualification (IQ), operational qualification (OQ) and performance qualification (PQ). After a system upgrade, the affected functions need to be revalidated.

blocks.zh: 電子簽名的法律效力：Part 11 下的電子簽名具有與手寫簽名相同的法律效力，但必須滿足：含有簽名者的全名、日期時間、以及簽名的「意義（meaning）」（如：已審核、已批准、已執行）。
blocks.en: Legal effect of electronic signatures: Under Part 11, an electronic signature has the same legal effect as a handwritten signature, but it must meet these conditions: it contains the signer's full name, the date and time, and the "meaning" of the signature (for example: reviewed, approved, executed).

blocks.zh: FDA Data Integrity 觀察項警示
blocks.en: FDA Data Integrity Observation Warnings

blocks.zh: ★ 稽核追蹤被關閉：在 FDA 檢查期間發現 LIMS 系統的稽核追蹤功能被管理員帳號關閉，導致無法追溯過去 6 個月的記錄修改歷史。這是數據完整性重大缺失，直接觸發 Warning Letter。
blocks.en: ★ Audit trail disabled: During an FDA inspection it was found that the audit trail function of the LIMS had been disabled through an administrator account, making it impossible to trace the modification history of records for the past 6 months. This is a major data integrity failure and directly triggers a Warning Letter.

blocks.zh: ★ 共用登入帳號：多名分析員使用同一個 LIMS 帳號，導致無法確認具體操作者。21 CFR Part 11 要求每個電子簽名必須唯一對應具體個人。
blocks.en: ★ Shared login accounts: Several analysts use the same LIMS account, so the specific operator cannot be identified. 21 CFR Part 11 requires every electronic signature to be uniquely linked to a specific individual.

blocks.zh: ★ 記錄保存系統未驗證：公司將 GMP 記錄存在未驗證的 Google Drive 或 Dropbox，沒有訪問控制，沒有稽核追蹤，不符合 Part 11。
blocks.en: ★ Record retention system not validated: The company stores GMP records on an unvalidated Google Drive or Dropbox, with no access control and no audit trail, which does not comply with Part 11.

blocks.zh: 你的公司生產一次性血糖測試條（效期 2 年）。倉庫管理員在翻找舊批次記錄時發現一批 2018 年製造的 DHR 遺失了。這違反了哪個法規要求？如何處理？
blocks.en: Your company manufactures disposable blood glucose test strips (shelf life 2 years). While searching through old batch records, the warehouse administrator finds that the DHR for a batch manufactured in 2018 is missing. Which regulatory requirement does this violate? How should it be handled?

blocks.zh: 公司準備將紙質批次記錄轉換為電子批次記錄（eBMR）。哪些 Part 11 功能是強制要求的？驗證計劃應涵蓋哪些內容？
blocks.en: The company plans to convert paper batch records to electronic batch records (eBMR). Which Part 11 functions are mandatory? What should the validation plan cover?

blocks.zh: FDA 查廠員要求看某特定批次的完整 DHR（Device History Record）。公司 DM 說「部分記錄在外部存儲設施，需要 3 天才能調取」。這是否符合 §820.180？
blocks.en: An FDA investigator asks to see the complete DHR (Device History Record) for a particular batch. The company's DM says "some of the records are at an external storage facility and it will take 3 days to retrieve them". Does this comply with §820.180?

blocks.zh: 記錄保存期限計算：實務場景
blocks.en: Record Retention Calculation: Practical Scenarios

blocks.zh: 記錄保存期限的計算常被誤解。關鍵原則：使用「器材設計/預期壽命」和「製造日期後 2 年」中更長的那個。
blocks.en: The calculation of record retention periods is often misunderstood. The key principle: use the longer of "device design/expected life" and "2 years after the date of manufacture".

blocks.zh: 注意：若器材被植入或用於挽救生命的情況，FDA 建議保存記錄直到最後已知使用的患者死亡——實務上許多公司採用「器材上市截止後 25 年」作為最大保存期限政策。
blocks.en: Note: for implanted devices or life-sustaining use, FDA recommends retaining records until the last known patient using the device has died. In practice, many companies adopt a maximum retention policy of "25 years after the device is withdrawn from the market".

blocks.zh: 4.6 Combination Product Considerations — QMSR + Drug GMP Cross-Requirements 4.6 組合產品考量 — QMSR 與藥品 GMP 交叉要求
blocks.en: 4.6 Combination Product Considerations — QMSR + Drug GMP Cross-Requirements

blocks.zh: 組合產品投訴處理的雙軌框架
blocks.en: The Dual-Track Framework for Combination Product Complaint Handling

blocks.zh: 最常見的挑戰：組合產品（如預填充注射器）收到一份投訴說「患者注射後出現嚴重過敏反應」。QA 必須同時評估：
blocks.en: The most common challenge: A combination product (such as a prefilled syringe) receives a complaint saying "the patient had a severe allergic reaction after the injection". QA must evaluate both of the following at the same time:

blocks.zh: 設備面（QMSR §820.198）：注射器是否洩漏？活塞是否失效？自動注射機制是否故障？→ 如果是，可能觸發 MDR（Part 803）
blocks.en: Device side (QMSR §820.198): Is the syringe leaking? Has the plunger failed? Has the auto-injector mechanism malfunctioned? → If so, an MDR (Part 803) may be triggered

blocks.zh: 藥品面（§211.198）：藥品配方、雜質、降解產物是否有問題？→ 如果是，可能觸發 ADE 報告（§314.81）
blocks.en: Drug side (§211.198): Is there a problem with the drug formulation, impurities or degradation products? → If so, an ADE report (§314.81) may be triggered

blocks.zh: 兩者都有可能：注射器故障導致藥品暴露於空氣（設備缺陷），同時降解產物造成過敏（藥品缺陷）→ 可能需要同時提交 MDR 和 ADE
blocks.en: Both are possible: A syringe malfunction exposes the drug to air (device defect), while degradation products cause the allergy (drug defect) → an MDR and an ADE may both need to be submitted

blocks.zh: 組合產品製造商必須在投訴 SOP 中明確這個雙軌評估流程，並有專人（或跨職能委員會）負責 MDR vs ADE 的最終決策。
blocks.en: A combination product manufacturer must define this dual-track evaluation process explicitly in the complaint SOP, and have a designated person (or a cross-functional committee) responsible for the final MDR vs ADE decision.

blocks.zh: 組合產品的雙軌報告就像一輛「油電混合汽車」的質保索賠：
blocks.en: Dual-track reporting for a combination product is like a warranty claim on a "hybrid car":

blocks.zh: 如果電動馬達故障（設備缺陷）→ 找設備保固部門
blocks.en: If the electric motor fails (device defect) → go to the device warranty department

blocks.zh: 如果汽油引擎燃油品質問題（藥品類比）→ 找燃油品質部門
blocks.en: If there is a fuel quality problem with the gasoline engine (the drug analogy) → go to the fuel quality department

blocks.zh: 如果是電控系統和燃油系統交互作用導致的故障 → 兩個部門都要處理
blocks.en: If the failure results from an interaction between the electronic control system and the fuel system → both departments must handle it

blocks.zh: 差別在於：醫療器材法規框架明確要求每次事件都必須文件化 MDR/ADE 的決策判斷，「不確定」不能作為不報告的理由——如果不確定，保守做法是報告。
blocks.en: The difference: the medical device regulatory framework explicitly requires that the MDR/ADE decision be documented for every event, and "uncertainty" cannot be used as a reason not to report. If in doubt, the conservative approach is to report.

blocks.zh: 組合產品合規常見陷阱
blocks.en: Common Compliance Pitfalls for Combination Products

blocks.zh: ★ PMOA 誤判：公司認為預填充注射器的 PMOA 是「藥品」，因此只設置了 ADE 報告流程，忽略了 §820.198 和 Part 803 的要求。FDA 認定注射器系統的設備功能（遞送機制）不應被忽略，即使 PMOA 是藥品。
blocks.en: ★ PMOA misjudgment: The company considers the PMOA of a prefilled syringe to be "drug", so it set up only an ADE reporting process and overlooked the requirements of §820.198 and Part 803. FDA holds that the device function of the syringe system (the delivery mechanism) must not be ignored, even when the PMOA is the drug.

blocks.zh: ★ 投訴文件只有一套：組合產品公司的 QMS 只有設備投訴文件程序（§820.198），沒有藥品投訴文件程序（§211.198）。FDA CGMP for Drugs 查廠時發現缺失。
blocks.en: ★ Only one complaint file system: The QMS of the combination product company has only a device complaint file procedure (§820.198) and no drug complaint file procedure (§211.198). The gap was found during an FDA CGMP for Drugs inspection.

blocks.zh: ★ MDR 和 ADE 部門互不知情：設備 QA 提交了 MDR 但沒有通知藥品法規事務部門；藥品法規事務部門提交了 ADE 但不知道設備端已有 MDR 提交。兩份報告對同一事件的描述不一致，引起 FDA 關注。
blocks.en: ★ MDR and ADE functions unaware of each other: Device QA submitted an MDR but did not notify the drug regulatory affairs department; the drug regulatory affairs department submitted an ADE without knowing that an MDR had already been submitted on the device side. The two reports described the same event inconsistently, which drew FDA attention.

blocks.zh: Key Comparison: QMSR CAPA vs ICH Q10 CAPA vs ISO 13485 §8.5 重點比較：QMSR CAPA 與 ICH Q10 CAPA 及 ISO 13485 §8.5
blocks.en: Key Comparison: QMSR CAPA vs ICH Q10 CAPA vs ISO 13485 §8.5

blocks.zh: 比較表 Comparison Table
blocks.en: Comparison Table

blocks.zh: 三大框架的本質差異
blocks.en: The Essential Differences Among the Three Frameworks

blocks.zh: FDA QMSR vs ICH Q10 的核心差異：QMSR 的 CAPA 強調「閉環系統的完整性」和「投訴→MDR 的法定義務連結」；ICH Q10 的 CAPA 更強調「科學調查的嚴謹性」和「APR（Annual Product Review）中趨勢數據的利用」。兩個框架對 VoE 的要求本質上相同，但 QMSR 對投訴處理的要求（§820.198）遠比藥品 GMP 複雜。
blocks.en: Core difference between FDA QMSR and ICH Q10: The QMSR CAPA emphasizes "the integrity of the closed-loop system" and "the statutory link from complaint to MDR"; the ICH Q10 CAPA places more emphasis on "the rigor of scientific investigation" and "the use of trend data in the APR (Annual Product Review)". The two frameworks are essentially the same in their VoE requirements, but the QMSR requirements for complaint handling (§820.198) are far more complex than those of drug GMP.

blocks.zh: ISO 13485 作為 QMSR 的底層：FDA QMSR 通過引用 ISO 13485 的方式整合了其 CAPA 要求。這意味著通過 ISO 13485 認證的製造商已滿足 QMSR 的大部分 CAPA 要求，但仍需要額外滿足 §820.198（投訴文件）和 21 CFR Part 803（MDR）的要求。
blocks.en: ISO 13485 as the foundation of QMSR: FDA QMSR incorporates its CAPA requirements by reference to ISO 13485. This means that a manufacturer certified to ISO 13485 already meets most of the QMSR CAPA requirements, but must still meet the additional requirements of §820.198 (complaint files) and 21 CFR Part 803 (MDR).

blocks.zh: 三框架的層次關係 Analogy
blocks.en: The Hierarchy of the Three Frameworks: Analogy

blocks.zh: 可以把三個框架想象成三種不同嚴格程度的駕駛執照要求：
blocks.en: Think of the three frameworks as driving licence requirements of three different levels of strictness:

blocks.zh: ISO 13485 = 國際駕照標準——全球通用基礎，定義了 CAPA 系統的最低要求
blocks.en: ISO 13485 = the international driving licence standard: a globally accepted baseline that defines the minimum requirements for a CAPA system

blocks.zh: ICH Q10 = 藥品行業的「高速公路駕駛考核」——更強調科學方法和數據，針對製藥流程的複雜性
blocks.en: ICH Q10 = the "highway driving test" of the pharmaceutical industry: more emphasis on scientific methods and data, addressing the complexity of pharmaceutical processes

blocks.zh: FDA QMSR = 美國聯邦法規下的醫療器材「特種車輛執照」——在 ISO 13485 基礎上，加上強制性的 MDR 報告義務和投訴文件要求，具有法律強制力
blocks.en: FDA QMSR = the "special vehicle licence" for medical devices under US federal regulation: on top of ISO 13485, it adds mandatory MDR reporting obligations and complaint file requirements, and it has the force of law

blocks.zh: 組合產品製造商同時需要「藥品高速公路駕照（ICH Q10）」和「器材特種車輛執照（QMSR）」——兩個都要滿足，不能互相替代。
blocks.en: A combination product manufacturer needs both the "drug highway licence (ICH Q10)" and the "device special vehicle licence (QMSR)". Both must be met, and neither can substitute for the other.

blocks.zh: Application Scenario — CDMO 場景：顆粒異物投訴完整決策樹
blocks.en: Application Scenario — CDMO Scenario: Complete Decision Tree for a Particulate Matter Complaint

blocks.zh: 應用場景 CDMO Scenario
blocks.en: Application Scenario: CDMO Scenario

blocks.zh: 背景：你的公司是一家 CDMO，為某醫療器材廠商充填並組裝預填充注射器（Prefilled Syringe, PFS）。客戶（NDA 持有人）致電你們的客服部門，說明他們從已配發的某批 PFS 中收到醫院退回的 3 支，外觀檢查發現藥液中有細小顆粒（particulate matter）。批次已全部配發（distributed），部分已用於患者。
blocks.en: Background: Your company is a CDMO that fills and assembles prefilled syringes (PFS) for a medical device manufacturer. The customer (the NDA holder) calls your customer service department to report that they received 3 PFS returned by a hospital from a distributed batch, and visual inspection found fine particles (particulate matter) in the drug solution. The entire batch has been distributed, and some units have already been used on patients.

blocks.zh: 完整 QMSR 決策樹 — 六個關鍵決策點：
blocks.en: Complete QMSR decision tree: six key decision points:

blocks.zh: 決策點 1：這是「投訴」嗎？（§820.198 定義審查）
blocks.en: Decision point 1: Is this a "complaint"? (review against the §820.198 definition)

blocks.zh: 通訊類型：客戶電話（oral communication）→ 必須立即書面化
blocks.en: Type of communication: customer phone call (oral communication) → must be documented in writing immediately

blocks.zh: 主張類型：質量缺陷（quality deficiency in distributed device/product）
blocks.en: Type of claim: quality defect (quality deficiency in distributed device/product)

blocks.zh: 配發狀態：已配發 ✓
blocks.en: Distribution status: distributed ✓

blocks.zh: 判斷：是，這是 §820.198 下的正式投訴。客服人員必須在接電話時或立即之後完成書面記錄，並路由至投訴管理部門（QA）。
blocks.en: Determination: Yes, this is a formal complaint under §820.198. The customer service representative must complete the written record during or immediately after the call and route it to complaint handling (QA).

blocks.zh: 決策點 2：需要調查嗎？
blocks.en: Decision point 2: Does it need to be investigated?

blocks.zh: 是否有過去相同投訴已有矯正行動？假設沒有 → 必須調查
blocks.en: Has a corrective action already been taken on an identical past complaint? Assume not → an investigation is required

blocks.zh: 調查範圍：回收退回樣品、提取批次充填記錄、檢查充填過程數據、IPC 顆粒計數記錄、濾器完整性測試記錄
blocks.en: Scope of investigation: retrieve the returned samples, pull the batch filling record, review filling process data, IPC particle count records and filter integrity test records

blocks.zh: 同步：客戶（NDA 持有人）應立即被告知，他們在 §820.198 下可能也有自己的投訴文件義務
blocks.en: In parallel: the customer (the NDA holder) should be notified immediately, as they may also have their own complaint file obligations under §820.198

blocks.zh: 決策點 3：這是不合格品（NCR）事件嗎？
blocks.en: Decision point 3: Is this a nonconforming product (NCR) event?

blocks.zh: 調查發現：退回 3 支 PFS 中確認有 ≥10μm 顆粒（超出 USP <788> 規格）
blocks.en: Investigation finding: particles ≥10 µm were confirmed in the 3 returned PFS (exceeding the USP <788> specification)

blocks.zh: 同批次已放行並配發：→ 已配發不合格品
blocks.en: The same batch has been released and distributed: → distributed nonconforming product

blocks.zh: NCR 開立：批次號、不合格描述、初步影響評估
blocks.en: NCR opened: batch number, description of the nonconformity, preliminary impact assessment

blocks.zh: 根本原因調查啟動（先於 CAPA）：充填環境監控回顧、充填針狀態、進料水和 API 顆粒數據
blocks.en: Root cause investigation started (ahead of CAPA): review of filling environment monitoring, condition of the filling needles, incoming water and API particle data

blocks.zh: 決策點 4：是否需要 MDR？（30 天計時已開始）
blocks.en: Decision point 4: Is an MDR required? (the 30-day clock has started)

blocks.zh: 計時起點（Day 0）：客服接到電話的當天
blocks.en: Clock start (Day 0): the day customer service received the call

blocks.zh: MDR 評估標準：
blocks.en: MDR evaluation criteria:

blocks.zh: 設備/產品故障是否可能導致死亡？未確認
blocks.en: May the device/product malfunction cause a death? Not confirmed

blocks.zh: 設備/產品故障是否可能導致嚴重傷害？→ 靜脈注射含顆粒藥品可導致栓塞（emboli）、血管閉塞、器官損傷 → 潛在嚴重傷害（serious injury）
blocks.en: May the device/product malfunction cause a serious injury? → Intravenous injection of a drug containing particles can cause emboli, vascular occlusion and organ damage → potential serious injury

blocks.zh: 若故障重複發生是否可能導致嚴重傷害？→ 是
blocks.en: If the malfunction recurred, could it cause a serious injury? → Yes

blocks.zh: 判斷：需要評估 MDR 報告。如果調查確認設備故障（充填系統問題），需在 Day 30 前向 FDA 提交 MDR（MedWatch 3500A）。
blocks.en: Determination: an MDR report must be evaluated. If the investigation confirms a device malfunction (a problem with the filling system), an MDR (MedWatch 3500A) must be submitted to FDA by Day 30.

blocks.zh: 注意：若患者已接受注射且出現不良反應 → 可能已觸發 ADE 報告義務（如果是組合產品，或 NDA 持有人有義務）
blocks.en: Note: if a patient has received the injection and had an adverse reaction → the ADE reporting obligation may already have been triggered (if it is a combination product, or if the NDA holder has the obligation)

blocks.zh: 決策點 5：是否需要場域糾正（Field Correction）或召回？
blocks.en: Decision point 5: Is a field correction or recall needed?

blocks.zh: 同批次 PFS 仍在流通？→ 評估召回可行性（21 CFR Part 806）
blocks.en: Is PFS from the same batch still in distribution? → Assess the feasibility of a recall (21 CFR Part 806)

blocks.zh: 問題是否可能影響其他批次？→ 向上/向下擴展調查範圍
blocks.en: Could the problem affect other batches? → Extend the scope of the investigation upstream/downstream

blocks.zh: FDA 通知義務：若確定啟動召回 → 需在 10 天內通知 FDA（或按醫院直接召回，視情況）
blocks.en: FDA notification obligation: if a recall is decided → FDA must be notified within 10 days (or, depending on the circumstances, the hospitals may be recalled directly)

blocks.zh: 決策點 6：是否觸發 CAPA？
blocks.en: Decision point 6: Is CAPA triggered?

blocks.zh: 若根本原因確認（如：充填針損耗未按計劃更換，導致金屬顆粒脫落）→ 強制觸發 CAPA
blocks.en: If the root cause is confirmed (for example: a filling needle was not replaced as scheduled due to wear, causing metal particles to shed) → CAPA is mandatory

blocks.zh: CAPA 範圍：充填針更換頻率 SOP 修訂、預防性維護計劃更新、在線顆粒監控強化
blocks.en: CAPA scope: revise the SOP for filling needle replacement frequency, update the preventive maintenance plan, strengthen in-line particle monitoring

blocks.zh: VoE 設計：後續連續 3 批次的顆粒計數數據符合 USP <788>
blocks.en: VoE design: particle count data from the next 3 consecutive batches conform to USP <788>

blocks.zh: 決策樹解析 Decision Tree Commentary
blocks.en: Decision Tree Commentary

blocks.zh: CDMO 與 NDA 持有人的責任分界
blocks.en: Division of Responsibility Between the CDMO and the NDA Holder

blocks.zh: 這個場景的特殊性在於：CDMO 是製造商（受 QMSR 管轄），但 NDA 持有人是藥品上市許可持有人（受藥品 GMP 管轄）。兩者的責任分界必須在品質協議（Quality Agreement）中預先明確：
blocks.en: What makes this scenario special is that the CDMO is the manufacturer (subject to QMSR), while the NDA holder is the drug marketing authorization holder (subject to drug GMP). The division of responsibility between the two must be defined in advance in the Quality Agreement:

blocks.zh: CDMO 義務：維護 §820.198 投訴文件、開立 NCR、執行技術調查、MDR 評估（設備面）、CAPA
blocks.en: CDMO obligations: maintain the §820.198 complaint file, open the NCR, carry out the technical investigation, MDR evaluation (device side), CAPA

blocks.zh: NDA 持有人義務：藥品投訴文件（§211.198）、ADE 報告、召回決策（21 CFR Part 806）、FDA 溝通主責
blocks.en: NDA holder obligations: drug complaint file (§211.198), ADE reporting, recall decision (21 CFR Part 806), primary responsibility for communication with FDA

blocks.zh: 共同義務：信息及時共享（QA 協議中明確時限）、MDR vs ADE 雙軌評估協調
blocks.en: Shared obligations: timely information sharing (time limits specified in the quality agreement), coordination of the dual-track MDR vs ADE evaluation

blocks.zh: 實務建議：質量協議應規定「投訴通知 CDMO 的時限（如 24 小時內）」和「CDMO 向 NDA 持有人回報調查進展的里程碑」。若無明確協議，FDA 查廠時兩方都可能面臨 483 觀察項。
blocks.en: Practical recommendation: The quality agreement should specify "the time limit for notifying the CDMO of a complaint (for example, within 24 hours)" and "milestones for the CDMO to report investigation progress to the NDA holder". Without a clear agreement, both parties may receive 483 observations during an FDA inspection.

blocks.zh: 此場景的 Top 3 合規風險點
blocks.en: Top 3 Compliance Risk Points in This Scenario

blocks.zh: ★ 風險 1：30 天 MDR 計時被忽視。CDMO 認為「MDR 是 NDA 持有人的義務」，沒有自己的 MDR 評估流程。但如果 CDMO 是設備製造商，在 §820.198 和 Part 803 下也有 MDR 評估義務。
blocks.en: ★ Risk 1: The 30-day MDR clock is ignored. The CDMO assumes that "MDR is the NDA holder's obligation" and has no MDR evaluation process of its own. But if the CDMO is the device manufacturer, it also has MDR evaluation obligations under §820.198 and Part 803.

blocks.zh: ★ 風險 2：根本原因分析過於表淺。充填後顆粒問題的 RCA 停在「充填環境偶發污染」，沒有追溯到維護計劃缺失或工程控制不足。VoE 就算通過，下一批次仍可能復發。
blocks.en: ★ Risk 2: The root cause analysis is too superficial. The RCA for the post-filling particle problem stops at "sporadic contamination of the filling environment" and does not trace back to a missing maintenance plan or inadequate engineering controls. Even if the VoE passes, the problem may recur in the next batch.

blocks.zh: ★ 風險 3：CAPA 未涵蓋其他批次評估。CAPA 只針對出問題的批次進行矯正，沒有回顧「在根本原因存在期間製造的其他批次」是否也受影響。FDA 查廠時會問：「你的 CAPA 是否評估了影響範圍？是否需要擴展到其他批次？」
blocks.en: ★ Risk 3: The CAPA does not cover evaluation of other batches. The CAPA corrects only the batch with the problem and does not review whether "other batches manufactured while the root cause existed" are also affected. During an FDA inspection, the question will be: "Did your CAPA assess the scope of impact? Does it need to be extended to other batches?"

blocks.zh: 場景延伸討論 Extended Scenario Discussion
blocks.en: Extended Scenario Discussion

blocks.zh: 延伸問題 1：調查發現，顆粒問題是由於充填室 HVAC 過濾器超過更換期限 45 天，但公司預防性維護記錄顯示「按計劃更換」。這個矛盾如何解釋？它對 CAPA 的根本原因分析有什麼影響？（提示：數據完整性問題）
blocks.en: Extended question 1: The investigation finds that the particle problem was caused by the filling room HVAC filter being 45 days past its replacement due date, but the company's preventive maintenance records show "replaced as scheduled". How do you explain this contradiction? What impact does it have on the root cause analysis of the CAPA? (Hint: a data integrity issue)

blocks.zh: 延伸問題 2：NDA 持有人決定啟動 Class II 召回（Recall）。作為 CDMO，你的 §820.198 投訴文件如何反映這個後續發展？召回是否需要更新 MDR？
blocks.en: Extended question 2: The NDA holder decides to initiate a Class II recall. As the CDMO, how should your §820.198 complaint file reflect this subsequent development? Does the recall require an MDR update?

blocks.zh: 延伸問題 3：3 個月後，你發現同類顆粒問題在另一個客戶的不同批次中再次出現。前一個 CAPA 的有效性驗證已「通過」。這說明了什麼？你的 CAPA 系統需要做什麼？
blocks.en: Extended question 3: 3 months later, you find that the same type of particle problem has recurred in a different batch for another customer. The effectiveness verification of the previous CAPA had "passed". What does this show? What does your CAPA system need to do?

blocks.en: Commentary Summary

blocks.zh: 六大核心記憶點
blocks.en: Six Core Takeaways

blocks.zh: §820.198 是 QMSR 獨有要求：投訴文件制度遠超 ISO 13485 的回饋要求，直接連結 MDR 強制報告義務——這是通過 ISO 13485 認證的非美國製造商進入美國市場時最容易被忽略的差異。
blocks.en: §820.198 is unique to QMSR: The complaint file system goes far beyond the feedback requirement of ISO 13485 and links directly to the mandatory MDR reporting obligation. This is the difference most easily overlooked by non-US manufacturers with ISO 13485 certification when entering the US market.

blocks.zh: CAPA 的「靈魂」是 VoE：有效性驗證（Verification of Effectiveness）是 CAPA 閉環的最終環節。沒有 VoE 的 CAPA 等於沒有完成 CAPA。這是 FDA Warning Letter 中引用最頻繁的 CAPA 缺陷。
blocks.en: The "soul" of CAPA is VoE: Verification of effectiveness (VoE) is the final link in the CAPA closed loop. A CAPA without VoE is a CAPA that has not been completed. This is the CAPA deficiency cited most frequently in FDA Warning Letters.

blocks.zh: MDR 30 天計時從「知悉」開始：不是從「調查完成」或「確認因果關係」開始。任何員工接收到相關信息即算「知悉」，公司必須有明確的投訴升級流程確保 QA 即時獲知。
blocks.en: The MDR 30-day clock starts from "awareness": Not from "completion of the investigation" or "confirmation of causation". Once any employee receives the relevant information, the company is considered "aware", and it must have a clear complaint escalation process to ensure that QA is informed immediately.

blocks.zh: 不合格品 + 已配發 = 強制 MDR 評估：每一次已配發產品的不合格發現，都必須走完整的 MDR 評估流程並文件化決策，即使最終判定不需要報告。
blocks.en: Nonconforming product + distributed = mandatory MDR evaluation: Every nonconformity found in distributed product must go through the full MDR evaluation process, with the decision documented, even if the final determination is that no report is required.

blocks.zh: 記錄保存期限 ≥ 器材設計壽命且 ≥ 2 年：植入物和長期使用器材的記錄保存往往超過 10 年，必須在 SOP 中明確定義各類器材的具體保存期限。
blocks.en: Record retention period ≥ device design life and ≥ 2 years: Record retention for implants and long-term-use devices often exceeds 10 years, and the specific retention period for each type of device must be clearly defined in the SOP.

blocks.zh: 組合產品雙軌義務：QMSR (§820.198) + 藥品 GMP (§211.198)，MDR (Part 803) + ADE (§314.81)。質量協議必須預先分配各方責任。
blocks.en: Dual-track obligations for combination products: QMSR (§820.198) + drug GMP (§211.198), MDR (Part 803) + ADE (§314.81). The quality agreement must allocate each party's responsibilities in advance.

blocks.zh: CAPA 系統的整體比喻
blocks.en: An Overall Analogy for the CAPA System

blocks.zh: 一個完整的 QMSR 質量保證系統，可以用人體免疫系統來比喻：
blocks.en: A complete QMSR quality assurance system can be compared to the human immune system:

blocks.zh: 不合格品管理 = 先天免疫（Innate immunity）：快速識別並隔離外來威脅（不良品），防止其「感染」（流入市場）
blocks.en: Nonconforming product control = innate immunity: quickly identifying and isolating external threats (defective product) and preventing them from "infecting" (reaching the market)

blocks.zh: CAPA 系統 = 適應性免疫（Adaptive immunity）：識別病原體模式（根本原因），建立長效保護（系統性矯正），並記住抗體（有效性驗證數據）防止復發
blocks.en: CAPA system = adaptive immunity: recognizing the pattern of the pathogen (the root cause), building long-lasting protection (systemic correction), and remembering the antibodies (effectiveness verification data) to prevent recurrence

blocks.zh: 投訴管理 §820.198 = 外部炎症監測器：患者/醫院的反饋是「疼痛信號」，必須系統性地傳遞到免疫中樞（QA），而不是被客服「止痛藥」壓制掉
blocks.en: Complaint handling §820.198 = the external inflammation monitor: feedback from patients and hospitals is the "pain signal" and must be passed systematically to the immune center (QA), rather than being suppressed by customer service with a "painkiller"

blocks.zh: MDR 報告 = 緊急求救信號（SOS）：當威脅超過個體能處理的範圍，必須上報到更高級別機構（FDA）協調應對
blocks.en: MDR reporting = the emergency distress signal (SOS): when a threat exceeds what the individual can handle, it must be escalated to a higher-level authority (FDA) to coordinate the response
